title: Publication output by primary OpenAlex field, 2021–2024
description: One row per classified field with yearly distinct work counts across all snapshot work types, four-year total, rank by total, endpoint count change and percent change relative to 2021.
code: with raw as (select t.field_id,t.field, count(distinct w.work_id) total, count(distinct w.work_id) filter(where publication_year=2021) y2021, count(distinct w.work_id) filter(where publication_year=2022) y2022,count(distinct w.work_id) filter(where publication_year=2023) y2023,count(distinct w.work_id) filter(where publication_year=2024) y2024 from works w join topics t on w.primary_topic_id=t.topic_id group by 1,2) select row_number() over(order by total desc,field_id) field_rank, *, y2024-y2021 change, round(100.0*(y2024-y2021)/nullif(y2021,0),1) pct_change from raw order by field_rank
